issue_request: FHIR-5717 asked for FHIR publishing tooling to warn when a derived Patient profile spreadsheet refers to elements that do not exist in the base resource, specifically Patient.nationality, Patient.nationality.extension, Patient.citizenship, and Patient.citizenship.extension in the historical HSPC Patient profile spreadsheet.
initial_application: The Jira comments are the authoritative application evidence found: Grahame Grieve stated on 2015-03-11 that the tooling now raised warnings for invalid element references, and the issue was later resolved/published for DSTU1. No current git commit or checked-in source path directly cites FHIR-5717.
additional_context: The current build scope in source/fhir.ini includes active core profile bundles and Patient resource source, not the historical HSPC Patient profile spreadsheet. Current searches found no Patient.nationality or Patient.citizenship profile elements in core; the only Patient citizenship occurrence in core is a valid extension example, with the extension definition maintained in the FHIR Extension Pack. Zulip and Confluence searches found no discussion that changes the Jira/source conclusion.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. No FHIR core source change is needed because the issue was a historical publisher/profile-spreadsheet validation fix and there is no remaining current core spec or build-scope profile artifact to correct.
